en.title: The Blind Map and the Lying Celestial Sphere
en.premise: I am the only one in the world who can love and protect my sister properly. The narrator, caring for a frail sister isolated from the outside world, relies on a secret map and star chart inherited from the previous generation to maintain a safe zone within the mansion and repel the ‘nameless intruder’ lurking inside. When his sister increasingly craves the outside world and discovers a passage not marked on the map, the hell the narrator has built under the name of ‘protection’ begins to crumble.

zh.title: 盲目之图与谎言的天球
zh.premise: 我是世界上唯一能正确地爱护并守护妹妹的人。病弱的妹妹被隔离在外界之外，叙述者依靠从前辈那里继承的秘密地图和星图，管理宅邸内的安全区，以驱逐潜伏在宅邸中的“无名侵入者”。然而，当妹妹逐渐渴望“外面”，并发现地图上没有标记的通道时，叙述者构筑的名为“守护”的地狱开始崩塌。
